ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the rising edge used by clocked processes; sequences updates of addr_ff, rdata (in some generates), mem_ram_b0..3 writes, rden and bus_rsp_o.ack. It times the entity's sequential behaviour.
ports.evidence: multiple processes with "if rising_edge(clk_i) then" assign addr_ff, rdata, mem_ram_b* and bus_feedback (lines with rising_edge(clk_i)).

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Acts as the asynchronous reset used by bus_feedback process; forces rden and bus_rsp_o.ack to '0' when asserted low, overriding their normal registered behaviour on reset.
ports.evidence: bus_feedback process sensitivity list and "if (rstn_i = '0') then" branch sets rden and bus_rsp_o.ack to '0'.

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Record bundle carrying bus request fields; the source fields (addr,data,ben,stb,rw) are consumed individually by internal logic rather than the aggregate itself.
ports.evidence: Only individual fields (bus_req_i.addr, .data, .ben, .stb, .rw) are referenced throughout the source (e.g. addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(...))).

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Supplies the requested byte address bits; the slice addr(addr_hi_c downto 2) is converted to an unsigned index and assigned to internal addr, which then indexes memories and may be captured into addr_ff.
role: carries bus address bits into entity

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Provides the 32-bit write data that supplies byte slices written into mem_ram_b0..3 when writes occur; each byte slice is captured into the corresponding mem_ram_bN element on a write.
ports.evidence: Assignments like mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0) inside mem_access process.

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Its individual bits gate which byte lanes are written: ben(0..3) are tested and, when '1' with stb and rw, allow the corresponding mem_ram_bN byte to be written from bus_req_i.data.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.ben(0) = '1') then mem_ram_b0(...) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0); (and similar for ben(1..3)).

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates an active bus transfer; it gates memory writes together with rw and ben, and it is sampled to form rden and to generate bus_rsp_o.ack according to IMEM_INIT.
ports.evidence: Used in conditions "if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1')" and in bus_feedback assignments for rden and bus_rsp_o.ack.

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Distinguishes reads from writes; used together with stb to enable memory writes, and sampled (negated) with stb to form rden and to influence bus_rsp_o.ack generation.
ports.evidence: Used in write condition and in rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw); bus_rsp_o.ack uses (not bus_req_i.rw) when IMEM_INIT.

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared request source field; not referenced anywhere in this source, so the entity neither consumes nor forwards it.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.src in the source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared privilege field; not referenced in this entity's source and therefore unused here.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.priv in the source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared debug field; not referenced in this entity's source and therefore unused here.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.debug in the source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared AMO indication field; it is not referenced in this entity's source and is unused here.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.amo in the source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Declared AMO operation field; not referenced anywhere in this source and therefore unused.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.amoop in the source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared lock field; not referenced in this source and unused by the entity.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.lock in the source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared fence field; not referenced in this source and unused by the entity.
ports.evidence: No occurrences of bus_req_i.fence in the source.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Output bundle carrying ack, err and data fields; the individual fields are driven inside this entity (ack registered, data and err driven concurrently), while the aggregate bus_rsp_o is not used as a whole.
ports.evidence: Individual fields bus_rsp_o.ack, .data and .err are assigned separately (bus_rsp_o.data <= ..., bus_rsp_o.err <= '0', bus_rsp_o.ack <= ...).

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Registered output that is assigned in bus_feedback process from bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw (and reset to '0'); reports acceptance/acknowledge of read transfers according to IMEM_INIT.
ports.evidence: In bus_feedback: on reset ack <= '0'; on rising_edge(clk_i) ack <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) or <= bus_req_i.stb (depending on IMEM_INIT).

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Constantly drives the error flag low; the entity does not derive it from any declared internal element.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Drives the response data bus from internal rdata when rden is '1', otherwise outputs zeros; thus its value is a function of rdata and the registered read-enable rden.

signals.name: rdata
signals.functionality: Holds the 32-bit word read from ROM or RAM. It is assigned from mem_rom_c(...) or from mem_ram_b0..3 indexed by addr/addr_ff and supplies bus_rsp_o.data when rden is asserted.
signals.evidence: Assignments: rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr)) or rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr_ff)); and rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)); rdata supplies bus_rsp_o.data.

signals.name: rden
signals.functionality: Captures stb and rw on the clock to produce a registered read enable (stb and not rw). It gates output data validity and is used by the bus response assignment.
signals.evidence: In bus_feedback: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) on rising_edge(clk_i); rden used in "bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else ..."

signals.name: addr
signals.functionality: Converts the incoming bus_req_i.addr slice into an unsigned index and supplies indexing for memory accesses and may be captured into addr_ff for timing alignment.
signals.evidence: addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2)); addr is used as index in mem_ram_bN(to_integer(addr)) and is captured into addr_ff in processes.

signals.name: addr_ff
signals.functionality: Captures addr on the clock in alt_style branches (or is forced to zero in other generates) and provides a stable index (addr_ff) used for ROM/RAM reads into rdata.
signals.evidence: addr_ff <= addr on rising_edge(clk_i) in alt_style generate; rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr_ff)) and mem_ram_bN(to_integer(addr_ff)) used to form rdata.

signals.name: mem_ram_b0
signals.functionality: Stores the least-significant byte of each 32-bit memory word; on writes (stb and rw and ben(0)) it captures bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0), and on reads supplies rdata(7 downto 0) via indexed accesses.
signals.evidence: mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0) inside mem_access; rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)).

signals.name: mem_ram_b1
signals.functionality: Stores the second byte of each 32-bit memory word; captures bus_req_i.data(15 downto 8) on writes gated by ben(1), and supplies rdata(15 downto 8) on reads.
signals.evidence: mem_ram_b1(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(15 downto 8); rdata(15 downto 8) <= mem_ram_b1(to_integer(addr)).

signals.name: mem_ram_b2
signals.functionality: Stores the third byte of each 32-bit memory word; captures bus_req_i.data(23 downto 16) on writes gated by ben(2), and supplies rdata(23 downto 16) on reads.
signals.evidence: mem_ram_b2(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(23 downto 16); rdata(23 downto 16) <= mem_ram_b2(to_integer(addr)).

signals.name: mem_ram_b3
signals.functionality: Stores the most-significant byte of each 32-bit memory word; captures bus_req_i.data(31 downto 24) on writes gated by ben(3), and supplies rdata(31 downto 24) on reads.
signals.evidence: mem_ram_b3(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(31 downto 24); rdata(31 downto 24) <= mem_ram_b3(to_integer(addr)).
